name: Qwen3.8-27B
description: Dense 27B vision-language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, supporting image and video input with a 262K native context.
research_notes: Card states 27B for the language model; HF safetensors metadata totals 27.78B (includes vision encoder). Supported-language list not given as codes in card. Release date not stated on card; HF repo created 2026-08-05. Publisher region left unknown: no fetched or cited page states Alibaba/Qwen HQ (qwen.ai/alibabacloud.com not reachable). Ollama library (maintained by Ollama, not Qwen) has qwen3.8:27b (18GB) and MLX tags (27b-mlx 18GB).

name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
description: Multimodal mixture-of-experts model from DeepSeek with 552B backbone parameters, image and text input and up to one-million-token context.
research_notes: Card: 552B backbone params, 8B/16B activated, plus 196B Engram memory; HF metadata totals 763B. Ollama library entry deepseek-v4.1-flash only has :cloud tags (hosted inference, not local), so not listed as a distribution. No official GGUF. Release date not on card; repo created 2026-09-10; a newer snapshot DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 exists (2026-10-17). Publisher region comes from a third-party page found via web search (not fetched directly).

name: GLM-5.3-Flash
description: Natively multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Z.ai with 320B total and 18B active parameters, combining sparse and linear attention.
research_notes: Ollama library glm-5.3-flash only has a :cloud tag (hosted), so not listed as local. Card links a Z.ai API (docs.z.ai, not fetched). Release date not stated; repo created 2026-08-25. Publisher region comes from a third-party page found via web search (not fetched directly).

name: Kimi K3
description: Open-weight native multimodal agentic model from Moonshot AI, 2.8T total and 104B activated parameters with a one-million-token context.
research_notes: Kimi K3 License: MIT-style with extra conditions for large Model-as-a-Service businesses (separate agreement above a revenue threshold). Weights are MXFP4 (quantization-aware). Ollama kimi-k3 is :cloud only. Suggested Kimi K2 is superseded; Kimi-K3.1-Pro (2026-11-02) also exists. Release date not stated; repo created 2026-06-13. Publisher region comes from a third-party page found via web search (not fetched directly).

name: Mistral Small 4 (119B, 2603)
description: Mixture-of-experts model from Mistral AI with 119B parameters, 6.5B active per token, 256K context and optional per-request reasoning.
research_notes: Card: multimodal input (text and image), text output; 128 experts, 4 active. No official GGUF; card points to third-party Unsloth GGUFs for llama.cpp. No Ollama library entry for Small 4 (only mistral-small3.x and community uploads). mistral.ai blocked. Release date not stated; '2603' suffix suggests March 2026 but not confirmed. Region source: news article calling it 'France-based'.

name: Falcon-H1-7B-Instruct
description: Instruction-tuned 7B hybrid-head language model from the Technology Innovation Institute, with official GGUF files for llama.cpp.
research_notes: Chose Falcon-H1 7B: TII's newest 2026 uploads are tiny/1.58-bit/vision models; H1 is the latest general instruct line found. License is the Falcon LLM License (custom; terms page on falconllm.tii.ae not fetched, host blocked). Params from HF safetensors metadata. Ollama only has older falcon/falcon2/falcon3. Released per repo creation 2025-05-01, not stated on card.

name: Jais-3-7B
description: Arabic-English 7B-class reasoning model with a 512K context window, released with official GGUF and MLX builds.
research_notes: Weights under HF org inception42 (verified org 'Inception42'); GGUF/MLX under IFM ('Institute of Foundation Models'); citation credits 'Team IFM'. Card says GGUF works with llama.cpp and Ollama, but no Ollama library entry (only community 'home-rag/jais-3'). MLX repo not individually fetched (listed in official card). HF safetensors metadata totals 9.0B; card calls it 7B-class. Publisher region unknown: ifm.ai/inceptionai.ai not reachable; web search did not give a clear HQ for IFM. Release date not stated; repo created 2026-09-29.

name: ALLaM-7B-Instruct (preview)
description: Arabic-English 7B instruction-tuned model trained from scratch by SDAIA's National Center for AI, with a 4K context.
research_notes: Card: developed by NCAI at SDAIA (Saudi Data & AI Authority); repo hosted under HF org 'HUMAIN'. Card license line says 'see LICENSE file'; HF metadata says apache-2.0. No official GGUF (third-party bartowski GGUF exists), no Ollama library entry. Release date not stated; repo created 2025-02-13 (still marked preview).

name: Nemotron-SEA-LION-v4.8-30B-A3B
description: Instruction-tuned hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE model from AI Singapore for English and seven Southeast Asian languages.
research_notes: Card: developed by AI Products Pillar, AI Singapore; funded by National Research Foundation Singapore. 'fil' is ISO 639-2 (Filipino) as listed by the card metadata. Params '30B-A3B' from model name; HF metadata totals 32.9B. Ollama entry is under the 'aisingapore' namespace (description names AI Singapore), not Ollama's library; ownership of that namespace not independently verified. Release date not stated; repo created 2026-09-08.

name: Sarvam-30B
description: Mixture-of-experts model from Sarvam AI with 2.4B active parameters, focused on English and 22 Indian languages.
research_notes: Language list from HF card metadata; some codes (kok, mai, doi, mni, sat) are ISO 639-2/3, not 639-1. '30B' from model name; HF metadata totals 32.2B. No Ollama library entry (community uploads only). Release date not stated; repo created 2026-03-03.

name: Qwen3-Swallow-8B-RL v0.2
description: Japanese-English 8B model built by continual pre-training of Qwen3, with improved Japanese and translation ability.
research_notes: Derived from Qwen3 (Alibaba) via the SFT checkpoint tokyotech-llm/Qwen3-Swallow-8B-SFT-v0.2. Release date is the card's family release-history entry (Feb 20, 2026). Card does not name the institution; region unknown. Official AWQ-INT4 variant exists; no official GGUF or Ollama library entry.

name: EXAONE 4.5 33B
description: Open-weight vision-language model from LG AI Research, strong in Korean and document understanding, with 262K context.
research_notes: License: EXAONE AI Model License Agreement 1.2 - NC (non-commercial). Licensor is LG Management Development Institute Co., Ltd., governed by Republic of Korea law, but no fetched page states HQ, so region left unknown. 31.7B LM + 1.29B vision encoder. Newer K-EXAONE-2.0 (750B) exists but is far from local-ready. No Ollama library entry for 4.5. Release date not stated; repo created 2026-04-04.

name: InkubaLM-0.4B
description: Small 0.4B language model from Lelapa AI for Swahili, Yoruba, Hausa, isiZulu and isiXhosa, plus English and French.
research_notes: HF repo is gated (auto-approval: accept terms). Card text lists French too, while card metadata omits 'fr'; I included fr from the card text. Weights are PyTorch .bin; no official GGUF (third-party QuantFactory GGUF exists) and no Ollama entry. Region unknown (lelapa.ai not reachable). Release date not stated; repo created 2024-05-11.

name: Tiny Aya Global
description: Small 3.35B multilingual research model from Cohere Labs covering 70+ languages, including many lower-resourced ones, with an 8K context.
research_notes: Main repo is gated (auto-approval); the official GGUF repo is not gated. GGUF card does not name a runtime, so local_runtimes left empty. Ollama library has older aya/aya-expanse, not Tiny Aya. License CC-BY-NC plus Cohere Labs Acceptable Use Policy. Region unknown (cohere.com not reachable). Release date not stated; repo created 2026-02-13.

name: Llama 4 Scout 17B-16E Instruct
description: Natively multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Meta with 17B active and 109B total parameters and up to 10M-token context.
research_notes: Llama 4 Community License (custom). HF repo gated with manual approval. Still the newest Llama release on HF as of today. Ollama llama4:scout is 67GB. Region unknown (no fetched source).

name: Gemma 4 12B IT
description: Instruction-tuned 12B open model from Google DeepMind taking text, image and audio input, with a 256K context.
research_notes: Card says 35+ languages supported, 140+ pretrained, without an ISO list, so languages unknown. License page on ai.google.dev not fetched (redirects to blocked host); license value from HF card. Ollama gemma4:12b is 7.7-8.0GB. Release date not stated; repo created 2026-05-23.

name: Phi-4-mini-instruct
description: Lightweight 3.8B dense model from Microsoft with 128K context and function calling, trained on synthetic and filtered web data.
research_notes: No newer general Phi instruct model found on HF (Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B from 2026-01 is a reasoning/vision variant). Ollama phi4-mini:3.8b is 2.5GB. Release date not stated; repo created 2025-02-19. Region unknown (no fetched source).

name: gpt-oss-20b
description: OpenAI's smaller open-weight reasoning model, 21B parameters with 3.6B active, aimed at local and lower-latency use.
research_notes: Card names Ollama (ollama pull gpt-oss:20b). Ollama gpt-oss:20b is 14GB. No newer gpt-oss found on HF. Release date not stated on card; repo created 2025-08-04. Region unknown (no fetched source).

name: Claude Sonnet 5.5

Supported regions page lists ~170 countries as an explicit allow-list (not phrased as exceptions), so countries left unknown per brief; see https://www.anthropic.com/legal/supported-regions (effective Nov 12, 2026). API billing is prepaid credits; free tier/trial not stated on fetched pages, so unknown. Region from privacy policy registered address (San Francisco).
